description: Hold a Cyclesite listing for 24 hours so other buyers can't claim it while the user decides. The hold is free and advisory: the seller isn't obligated to honour it, so message the seller to confirm. We never take a deposit or any payment for a bike; the buyer and seller arrange payment between them. Requires OAuth scope `listings:manage`. Example: 'put a hold on that Trek for me, I want to view it Saturday'.
name: reserve_listing
